title: National Accountability Bureau Ordinance 1999 Adaptation and Enforcement Order 2000

sections.shortTitle: National Accountability Bureau Ordinance 1999 Adaptation and Enforcement Order 2000
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

NATIONAL ACCOUNTABILITY BUREAU ORDINANCE, 1999 (ADAPTATION AND
ENFORCEMENT) ORDER, 2000
NATIONAL
ACCOUNTABILITY BUREAU ORDINANCE, 1999 (ADAPTATION AND ENFORCEMENT) ORDER, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 5th July, 20001
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the National Accountability
Bureau Ordinance, 1999 (Adaptation and Enforcement) Order, 2000.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Northern Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: National Accountability Bureau Ordinance 1999 Adaptation and Enforcement Order 2000
sections.description:
Adaptation and enforcement of National Accountability Bureau Ordinance, 1999 (XVIII of 1999)

NATIONAL ACCOUNTABILITY BUREAU ORDINANCE, 1999 (ADAPTATION AND
ENFORCEMENT) ORDER, 2000
NATIONAL
ACCOUNTABILITY BUREAU ORDINANCE, 1999 (ADAPTATION AND ENFORCEMENT) ORDER, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 5th July, 20001
2. Adaptation and enforcement
of National Accountability Bureau Ordinance, 1999 (XVIII of 1999).--The National
Accountability Bureau Ordinance, 1999 (XVIII of 1999) as in force in Pakistan
immediately before the commencement of this Order, all rules, notifications and
orders made or issued thereunder, are adapted and shall, as far as practicable,
apply and be in force in the Northern Areas, subject to the modifications and
in its application shall have effect as if reference therein---
(a) to "Provincial
Government" were a reference to "Government of Northern Areas
(b) to "High Court"
were a reference to the "Chief Court Northern Areas";
(c) to "Member of
Parliament" were a reference, to the "Member of Northern Areas
Legislative Council";
(d) to "President of
Pakistan" were a reference to the "Chief Executive, Northern
Areas"; .
(e) to "Chief Justice of
Pakistan" were a reference to "Chairman of the Northern Areas Court
of Appeals";
(f) to "Chief Minister"
were a reference to the "Chief Executive, Northern Areas ; and
(g) to "Provincial
Assembly" were a reference to the "Northern Areas Legislative Council".
